name: Priya Kapoor
text: I was terrified of dental visits for years. Dr. Siddharth and his team completely changed my experience. Painless whitening and such a calming atmosphere — felt like a spa, not a clinic!

name: Rajesh Mehra
text: The online booking on their website took just 30 seconds — so convenient! Got my clear aligners consultation booked seamlessly. Zero waiting time at the clinic too. 10/10 service.

name: Sneha Iyer
text: Extremely clean clinic with state-of-the-art equipment. They explained every step before starting. Transparent pricing with zero hidden fees. Best dental experience in Delhi!

name: Arjun Malhotra
text: Had an emergency toothache on a Saturday. DentEase fit me in within 2 hours. Professional, empathetic, and truly top-tier care. The EMI option for my implant was a lifesaver too.

name: Kavita Reddy
text: My kids actually look forward to their dental checkups now! Dr. Siddharth is so gentle and patient with children. The kid-friendly waiting area is such a thoughtful touch. Highly recommend to families.
